subject: POC trial plan & final readout scheduling - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme-health.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@acme-health.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & POC plan for Acme Health trial

Hi Jordan and Priya,

Thanks again for the call today - really appreciate the clarity on the use case (clinical note summarization + search relevance for clinician workflows). As discussed, attached is a first-pass POC plan and an initial set of success criteria. High-level summary:

- Objective: Validate that Redwood reduces average clinician query latency and improves relevance of returned snippets for the top 3 note types (admissions, discharge summaries, consult notes).
- Success criteria (proposed):
  1) Mean generation latency <= 250ms at 50 RPS sustained for a 512-token max context.
  2) Relevance improvement: +15% on your internal relevance score vs baseline for the evaluation prompt set.
  3) No PHI leakage seen in N-of-100 sample outputs (we will run redaction/adaptive masking).
- Evaluation window: 7 business days of steady-state traffic + focused evals on a 200-case test set.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm stakeholders for the final readout (execs + procurement) and a target decision date.
2) We finalize the mutual action plan and success criteria - attached (MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v2.pdf) and POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx.
3) Marcus will kick off integration support for data ingestion and David will scope contracting/payment options for a short reserved capacity pilot if you expect sustained load.
4) We schedule a final readout for the week of Mar 2 - suggested slots: Tue 3/9 10:00-10:30 AM ET or Wed 3/10 2:00-2:30 PM ET. Please confirm what works for your execs.

Attachments: POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx, MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v2.pdf, Trial_Instructions.md

If that all sounds good I'll update the plan and Marcus will follow up with the engineering checklist.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Final readout attendees: Jordan Ellis (VP Product), Priya Natarajan (Director Clinical Ops), Samira Patel (Procurement Manager - samira.patel@acme-health.com) and one of our clinical leads (TBD).

Decision process on the readout:
- Executive review (Jordan + Priya) will make a recommend/go/no-go decision based on the success criteria and sample outputs.
- If recommend-go, procurement (Samira) will engage with David to finalize a short reserved-capacity pilot contract. We will need an estimate for a 3-month pilot (capacity: ~100 RPS peak, average 30 RPS).

We can confirm Tue Mar 9, 10:00 AM ET for the final readout. Please send the calendar invite and readout template.

Regards,

Thanks team - see you on Tue.
